@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/internal/v1/ingestion") public class HistoricalContractApi {private final HistoricalContractService history;private final TrustedAuthorizationContext authorization;public HistoricalContractApi(HistoricalContractService history,TrustedAuthorizationContext authorization){this.history=history;this.authorization=authorization;}public record ContractRequest(String contractRef){}public record HoldRequest(String contractRef,String action,String reason){}@GetMapping("/contracts/runs/{runId}")Map<String,Object> contracts(@PathVariable UUID runId,HttpServletRequest request){return history.runContracts(runId,authorization.require(request,"ingestion.contract.read",false));}@GetMapping("/runs/{runId}/lineage")Map<String,Object> lineage(@PathVariable UUID runId,@RequestParam(defaultValue="100")int limit,HttpServletRequest request){return Map.of("items",history.lineage(runId,authorization.require(request,"ingestion.lineage.read",false),limit));}@PostMapping("/contracts/deletion-check")Map<String,Object> deletionCheck(@RequestBody ContractRequest body,HttpServletRequest request){return history.deletionCheck(body.contractRef(),authorization.require(request,"ingestion.contract.delete-check",false));}@PostMapping("/contracts/assert-removable")void assertRemovable(@RequestBody ContractRequest body,HttpServletRequest request){history.assertRemovable(body.contractRef(),authorization.require(request,"ingestion.contract.delete",false));}@PostMapping("/contracts/legal-hold")void legalHold(@RequestBody HoldRequest body,@RequestHeader(value="X-Correlation-ID",required=false)String correlation,HttpServletRequest request){history.legalHold(body.contractRef(),body.action(),body.reason(),authorization.require(request,"ingestion.contract.legal-hold",true),correlation==null||correlation.isBlank()?UUID.randomUUID().toString():correlation);}}

@PostMapping("/search") Map<String,Object> search(@RequestBody Query q,@RequestHeader HttpHeaders headers,HttpServletRequest request){String c=correlation(headers);try{return logs.search(toSearch(q),protectedActor(request,"ingestion.log.read"),c);}catch(ResponseStatusException denied){logs.denied(request,"SEARCH",q.purpose(),c);throw denied;}}

@PostMapping("/aggregate") Map<String,Object> aggregate(@RequestBody Aggregate q,@RequestHeader HttpHeaders headers,HttpServletRequest request){String c=correlation(headers);try{return Map.of("items",logs.aggregate(toSearch(q.query()),q.dimension(),protectedActor(request,"ingestion.log.aggregate"),c));}catch(ResponseStatusException denied){logs.denied(request,"AGGREGATE",q.query()==null?null:q.query().purpose(),c);throw denied;}}
